steps.label: Preheat
steps.text: Cast iron on medium-high 5 min. Do steps 2–4 meanwhile.

steps.label: Veg
steps.text: Halve 190 g tomatoes, thin-slice 60 g red onion, chop 75 g cilantro.

steps.label: Dressing in bowl
steps.text: Whisk 150 g yogurt, 40 g mayo, 20 g lime juice, 4 g honey, ¼ tsp salt, pepper in the bottom of the salad bowl. Pile veg and 250 g diced avocado on top; don't toss.

steps.label: Char corn
steps.text: 115 g frozen corn in dry skillet 3 min, stirring once. Add to bowl.

steps.label: Season chicken
steps.text: Pat 600 g chicken dry on board; coat both sides with spice mix.

steps.label: Sear
steps.text: 20 g oil in skillet. Sear chicken 3 min per side to 160°F (71°C). Rest on board 5 min (carryover to 165°F).

steps.label: Toss
steps.text: Slice chicken, add to bowl, toss. Pack 2 lunch portions now.

steps.label: Balance
steps.text: MyPlate needs grain + fruit: add warm whole-wheat tortillas and a piece of fruit.

notes: Upgrade: dressing made in the salad bowl (one less bowl); corn charred in the same skillet.

steps.label: Rice
steps.text: Rinse 300 g rice in the cooker pot, drain, add water to line 2 (White scale). Start.

steps.label: Veg
steps.text: Cut zucchini, pepper, beans; grate frozen ginger, press garlic.

steps.label: Velvet
steps.text: Slice 500 g chicken; toss in bowl with 8 g cornstarch, 15 g water, 5 g oil. Rest while you continue.

steps.label: Bloom paste
steps.text: Wok on medium, 15 g oil. Fry 70 g curry paste 90 sec. Add ginger and garlic 20 sec.

steps.label: Liquids
steps.text: Add coconut milk and 300 g stock; whisk. Bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.label: Chicken
steps.text: Add velveted chicken; simmer 5 min (no hard boil, coconut milk splits).

steps.label: Veg
steps.text: Add beans and pepper 2 min, then zucchini 2 min.

steps.label: Season
steps.text: Off heat, stir in 20 g fish sauce, 12 g brown sugar, 20 g lime juice. Fold in basil. Serve over rice.

notes: Upgrade: velveted thighs stay silky and cook in 5 min; more veg for MyPlate.

ingredient_groups.label: Tools
items: Microwave-safe large bowl, stand or hand mixer bowl, spatula, 4 cups

ingredient_groups.label: Mise en place (clockwise, in order of use)
items: Dark chocolate 170 g (6 oz), chopped + butter 30 g (2 tbsp): in large bowl

Sugar 50 g (¼ cup), split 25 g + 25 g

steps.label: Melt
steps.text: Microwave chocolate + butter at 50% power 60 sec, stir, then 30 sec; stir smooth. Cool 5 min.

steps.label: Yolks
steps.text: Whisk yolks with 25 g sugar and vanilla; stir into chocolate.

steps.label: Whites
steps.text: Whip whites with salt to soft peaks; add 25 g sugar; whip 1 min to glossy peaks.

steps.label: Fold
steps.text: Stir 1 spoonful of whites into chocolate, then fold in the rest.

steps.label: Chill
steps.text: Portion into 4 cups; chill 2 hr. Serve plain or with a spoon of whipped cream.

notes: Kids + raw eggs: pasteurize in shell with the sous-vide wand at 135°F (57°C) for 75 min, then chill. Microwave melt replaces the steam bath (no pot).

steps.label: Pressure
steps.text: High 60 min, natural release 15 min.

steps.label: Shred
steps.text: Pork out, shred with 2 forks; skim fat from the liquid.

steps.label: Sauce
steps.text: Pork back in with BBQ sauce + 120 ml (½ cup) cooking liquid. Optional: broil on sheet pan 4 min for crisp edges.

steps.label: Serve
steps.text: On buns with a bagged coleslaw kit.

notes: Imose's list had only the name. This is a pulled pork version for buns; ask Imose what makes it "Hawgarama" and I'll update it.

title: Caramelized Onion Batch (Freezer)
meta: Batch · Makes about 5 cups | 20 min Active | 1 hr 10 min Total
tools: Instant Pot, mandoline, sheet pan, 5 freezer bags
mise: Butter 60 g (4 tbsp)
Yellow onions 2.3 kg (10 medium): halve, mandoline thin
Salt 6 g (1 tsp), water 120 ml (½ cup)

ingredient_groups.label: Tools
items: Instant Pot, mandoline, sheet pan, 5 freezer bags

ingredient_groups.label: Mise en place (clockwise, in order of use)
items: Butter 60 g (4 tbsp)
Yellow onions 2.3 kg (10 medium): halve, mandoline thin
Salt 6 g (1 tsp), water 120 ml (½ cup)

steps.label: Soften
steps.text: Sauté mode, butter; onions, salt, water. Lid on, High 30 min, quick release.

steps.label: Caramelize
steps.text: Sauté (More), lid off, 25 min, stirring every 5 min, until deep brown and dry.

steps.label: Cool
steps.text: Spread on the sheet pan 15 min.

steps.label: Freeze
steps.text: 1 cup per bag, pressed flat; label. Keeps 3 months.

steps.text: French Onion Soup (040), BBQ Pork Sandwich (075), Lentil Soup (078), Mujaddara (150), burgers and pizza.
